rules: Preserve grades S/M/L/G/P/X exactly as displayed in the source.
Item names use sentence capitalization, not English Title Case.
Do not silently fix source typos or infer undocumented variable meanings.
Use Hè for Summer consistently across HUD, calendar, birthday UI and prose (lowercase hè in prose).
Character pronouns apply only to the documented scene and player age; do not extend childhood speech to adult scenes.
External wikis may clarify concepts but never replace ROM text, source IDs or control codes.
Base tool description headings Sickle/Hoe remain Liềm/Cuốc; do not add Iron merely because the separate item-name table says Iron.

Flour is food ID 0x42, misspelled Flower in the item table; identity verified by the matching ordered grocery list in script.1043.108. Explicit source defects are documented in docs/ITEM_LOCALIZATION.md.
Daily NPC pronouns are source-ID scoped: Thomas bác/cháu in script 1017; Popuri mình/bạn in 993.093-143 only. Do not extend to player-spouse dialogue without checking relationship branches.
